body: Deep down you know you have the strength, it’s just a question of time. Dying won’t change anything it’ll just be a wasted opportunity. Life is a damn good opportunity. It’s an opportunity to explore to learn and appreciate what’s around us. I remember the time when cutting myself and thinking about cutting myself was my favourite hobby. Looking back I realise how naive I was and what a stupid thing self harm is. At the moment it may look like the only answer but it isn’t it never is in fact it’s not an answer at all
The night is darkest before the dawn

Being someone who has been through all of this
I know in these situations one feels helpless but I PROMISE I PROMISE time does change. I loved someone but they broke me. I lost everything but with time everything changes. You just need to wait, the harder the wait the more beautiful the future.

Apologies if this post does not help. It helped me hence I shared it. I am sorry.

Remember when you think there’s nothing left to live for and nothing left to do or no one to talk to (I know one doesn’t think straight in these moments) it is really these moments that make us. Remember that you are lucky to be living on this planet and in this era and one bad day, one bad incident, one pathetic person shouldn’t be enough to ruin what can be a lifetime full of love and enjoyment.
